description: Returns a list of workflows bulk replace requests.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with matching status.

parameters.name: filters[old_assignee_ids]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with any of the matching old assignees.

parameters.name: filters[new_assignee_ids]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with any of the matching new assignees.

parameters.name: filters[updated_by_id]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with any of the matching updated by users.

parameters.name: filters[type]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests by replacement type (temporary or permanent).

parameters.name: filters[start_date]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests by start date range. Format: ISO 8601 date range "YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: filters[end_date]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests by end date range. Format: ISO 8601 date range "YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort the results by specified fields. Supported fields: updated_by, status, old_assignee, updated_at, start_date, end_date, type

data.description: List of workflow bulk replace requests

id.description: ID of the bulk replace request

status.description: Status of the bulk replace request

replacement_type.description: Replacement Type of the bulk replace request

old_assignee.description: The old assignee to be replaced by the bulk replace request

new_assignees.description: List of new assignees requested to replace the old assignee

start_date.description: Date the bulk replace request will start (only applies to requests with temporary replacement_type)

end_date.description: Date the bulk replace request will end (only applies to requests with temporary replacement_type)

modify_project_roles.description: Whether the bulk replace request should replace the assignees for project roles

project_ids.description: List of project ids within which the bulk replace request will be applied (empty list means all projects)

tools.description: List of tools to which the bulk replace request will be applied (empty list means all tools)

stopped_at.description: When the bulk replace request was stopped

has_errors.description: Whether the bulk replace request has encountered errors
